actions.objective: Remove the exact lost Tailscale device and any affected SSH or provider session before replacement enrollment.
actions.containment: Keep the replacement outside the tailnet until the individual identity and least-privilege role are confirmed.
actions.release_verification: Observe revoked-device rejection and replacement-device TCP 443 access on the selected release VM without recording private addresses.

actions.objective: Revoke one account or all application sessions and reset affected password and MFA credentials through guarded console operations.
actions.containment: Use the narrowest scope and preserve protected audit events for every affected household.
actions.release_verification: Prove retired cookies, password, TOTP, and recovery code fail before fresh enrollment on the selected candidate.

actions.objective: Stop ingress and disconnect a suspected compromised VM from the tailnet before rebuilding from a known-good system.
actions.containment: Do not rotate in place after suspected root, Docker, database-administrator, backup-key, or audit-key compromise.
actions.release_verification: Record the bounded VM and tailnet isolation procedure during the release-host tabletop.

actions.objective: Preserve the incident window from the collector-only archive, host logs, and external signed audit checkpoints before destructive work.
actions.containment: Never create a fresh checkpoint over an unexplained audit-chain failure or delete the affected system before preservation.
actions.release_verification: Preserve a sanitized incident-window summary and verify access to the restricted raw archive and matching offline checkpoint.

actions.objective: Rotate application, MFA, PostgreSQL, Restic, audit, Tailscale, SSH, and identity-provider credentials according to compromise scope.
actions.containment: Stage one bounded generation at a time, prove replacement access, and reject retired access before resuming ingress.
actions.release_verification: Exercise the applicable rotations on the selected release boundary and retain only sanitized outcomes.

actions.objective: Review dependency, image, host, application, database, network, and security-log indicators before selecting a recovery point.
actions.containment: Treat an unexplained integrity failure, unaccepted severe finding, or unexpected administrative access as release blocking.
actions.release_verification: Review current scanner results and bounded host indicators against the incident window on a known-good device.

actions.objective: Select a pre-incident encrypted snapshot and restore it into a new protected target without overwriting the affected system.
actions.containment: Reject live or existing restore targets and preserve the affected VM for investigation.
actions.release_verification: Perform and time a clean off-VM restore of the selected release snapshot.

actions.objective: Verify every restored household audit chain against its matching independently signed external checkpoint.
actions.containment: Fail closed on chain, count, key ID, signature profile, or checkpoint mismatch.
actions.release_verification: Record pass or failure for each restored household without retaining raw audit content.

actions.objective: Require fresh password-plus-MFA enrollment and individually approved least-privilege Tailscale devices after containment.
actions.containment: Do not weaken MFA, tailnet policy, host validation, or firewall rules to recover access.
actions.release_verification: Confirm both intended members can enroll and the revoked device remains unable to connect.

actions.objective: Record dates, operator, release, affected credential classes, outcomes, findings, recovery time, and corrective actions without restricted values.
actions.containment: Keep raw logs and proof material in restricted incident storage and commit only sanitized summaries.
actions.release_verification: Complete a dated sanitized record bound to the exact release candidate after the tabletop and recovery exercise.

rehearsals.proves: MFA key rotation, retired-key rejection, emergency password and MFA reset, session and recovery-code revocation, fresh enrollment, and protected audit evidence on disposable data.
rehearsals.limitation: Does not revoke a real Tailscale device or rotate production host credentials.

rehearsals.proves: Replacement Restic access, retired-key rejection, clean-target restoration, full fixture integrity, audit-chain verification, and signed checkpoint verification.
rehearsals.limitation: Uses disposable storage rather than the real off-VM repository and selected release host.

rehearsals.proves: Exact private hostname, tagged server identity, HTTPS-only Serve configuration, Funnel rejection, deny-by-default firewall, and loopback-only application listener.
rehearsals.limitation: Must run on the real VM and therefore remains release-candidate evidence.
